name: Bottled Thunder
description: Collect charged horns from Thunder Rams on the Ancient Steppe.

dialogue.offer: Four Thunder Horns could power my new bellows without coal. The rams roam the Ancient Steppe.
dialogue.in_progress: Listen for thunder without clouds. That will lead you to the rams.
dialogue.ready: The charge in these horns is remarkable. Stand back while I ground them.
dialogue.completed: The new bellows roar like a summer storm.
